proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ _ s A B X Y hA hB hX hY hAB hs
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℝ V := FiniteDimensional.of_fact_finrank_eq_two
  haveI : Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2) := ⟨Module.Basis.orientation (Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq ℝ V Fact.out)⟩
  have hmA := left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A B
  have hmB := right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A B
  have hXA : X ≠ A := fun h => hs.2.1 (h ▸ hmA)
  have hXB : X ≠ B := fun h => hs.2.1 (h ▸ hmB)
  have hYA : Y ≠ A := fun h => hs.2.2 (h ▸ hmA)
  have hYB : Y ≠ B := fun h => hs.2.2 (h ▸ hmB)
  have h2 := EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.two_zsmul_oangle_eq hA hX hY hB hXA hXB hYA hYB
  have hsign := hs.oangle_sign_eq hmA hmB
  have hne : (EuclideanGeometry.oangle A X B).sign ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hcol := EuclideanGeometry.oangle_sign_eq_zero_iff_collinear.mp h0
    exact hs.2.1 (hcol.mem_affineSpan_of_mem_of_ne (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) hAB)
  rw [EuclideanGeometry.angle_eq_iff_oangle_eq_of_sign_eq hXA.symm hXB.symm hYA.symm hYB.symm hsign.symm]
  exact (Real.Angle.two_zsmul_eq_iff_eq hne hsign.symm).mp h2
